dag.summary: Cryptobom-forge is a Python CLI tool that generates and validates Cryptographic Bills of Materials (CBOMs) from CodeQL SARIF analysis results. The architecture centers around a CLI entry point that orchestrates two main subsystems: a parser module that transforms SARIF output into structured cryptographic components (algorithms, certificates, and related crypto material) using library definition lookups, and a cryptocheck engine that validates the resulting CBOM against configurable rules and schemas. Static YAML/JSON resources define the cryptographic library mappings and validation rules. The project follows standard Python packaging conventions with tox for test orchestration, GitHub Actions for CI/CD, and a clean separation between unit tests (testing individual parser components) and integration tests (validating end-to-end CBOM generation).
